description: Defines the SliceSPMDExpander class, which inherits from SPMDExpanderBase, and declares methods for expanding operations and computing layouts within the Slice SPMD expansion for TensorFlow's DTensor MLIR framework.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)
StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& output_layouts)

classes.name: SliceSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class for expanding slice operations in the SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) model within TensorFlow's MLIR-based DTensor framework.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the given MLIR operation into its SPMD form.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the input layout for the operation based on the output layout, propagating layout constraints forward.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the output layout for the operation based on the input layout, propagating layout constraints backward.
